title: Journalist threatened with arrest at the ESA sergeants' school over Varginha case
place_text: Escola de Sargentos das Armas (ESA), Três Corações, Brazil

tellings.quote: We were investigating the case at the ESA headquarters, the Sergeant School of Arms, and I had never been arrested for doing my job, neither before nor after this case.

plain: A Brazilian journalist, unnamed in the telling, says that in 1996 he was investigating the Varginha case, a story from Brazil in which people say the army captured a living non-human creature, at the army's sergeants' school in the town of Três Corações. According to him, he was threatened with arrest there, something that had never happened to him for doing his job before or after, and he names people called Uklides and Cal in connection with it. If true, it would suggest the military was working to keep the case quiet.
